fields.description: Shown in the Vue app's sidebar header and on the login page.
fields.label: App Name

fields.description: Shown in the app's sidebar header when the app is in light mode. Falls back to a plain initial-letter mark if left blank.
fields.label: App Logo (Light Mode)

fields.description: Shown in the app's sidebar header when the app is in dark mode. Falls back to the light-mode logo, then a plain initial-letter mark, if left blank.
fields.label: App Logo (Dark Mode)

fields.description: Primary color used for buttons, active navigation, and highlights across the app. Defaults to near-black.
fields.label: Accent Color

fields.description: Shown in the sidebar footer, e.g. v2.0.
fields.label: App Version

fields.description: Shown as a Help Desk shortcut in the sidebar, below Search/Notifications. Leave blank to hide it.
fields.label: Help Desk URL

fields.default: Budgets, disbursements and utilisation, in one place.
fields.description: Short headline shown on the login page.
fields.label: Login Headline

fields.default: Track partner budgets, monitor utilisation, and keep reporting on schedule.
fields.description: Supporting text shown below the headline on the login page.
fields.label: Login Description

fields.description: Turns the floating AI assistant on or off for every user of the app.
fields.label: Enable AI Assistant

fields.description: Only users with at least one of these roles see the assistant and can use it. Leave empty to allow every logged-in user (once enabled above).
fields.label: Allowed Roles

fields.description: Shown as the chat panel's title and greeting.
fields.label: Assistant Name

fields.description: Maximum number of assistant messages a single user can send per day. Protects against unexpected API costs.
fields.label: Daily Message Limit Per User

fields.description: Maximum number of assistant requests allowed to run at the same time, site-wide. This server runs the background worker shared across every site on the bench, so this cap keeps the AI assistant from starving other sites of worker capacity. Keep this low (2-3).
fields.label: Max Concurrent Assistant Jobs

fields.description: OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
fields.label: API Base URL

fields.description: Model name as the provider lists it, e.g. google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite on OpenRouter.
fields.label: Model

fields.description: Stored encrypted, never sent to the browser. Leave blank for providers that don't require a key (e.g. local Ollama).
fields.label: API Key
